Published: Updated 23 Nov 2026, 6:15 AM EST (CBS/AP)
(Extracted article content)
Zelenskyy said seven domestically made naval drones sank the Russian corvette Merkury, one of Russia's newest ships, commissioned in 2023; Ka-27 helicopter destroyed.
Zelenskyy: "Despite all the enemy's efforts to counter the attack, the Russian corvette Merkury was sunk."
Two Libyan officials said the corvette was severely damaged at the Benghazi Naval Base. Residents heard explosions and saw fire early Sunday; civil defence extinguished it.
Ukrainian forces also struck dry cargo ship MV Angara off Libya; under US and international sanctions.
Sparta II: Russia-linked cargo ship operated by Oboronlogistika hit by drones Saturday in the Gulf of Finland, fire; all crew rescued. Finland's military said likely a Ukrainian strike. Kyiv has neither confirmed nor denied.
Kremlin no immediate comment; defence ministry to provide information later.
UNSMIL: "Libya cannot afford, and must not become a battleground for foreign conflicts." Called for "an immediate, independent and transparent investigation."
Libyan officials said Ukrainian forces operate in western Libya under a covert, Western-endorsed deal, and used Libyan territory to strike a Russian tanker in March.
SBU called the operation "unique"; drones launched from a "mothership" near the target. About 1,500 miles from the front line.
Regional authorities said 17 people were killed, including one child, in Russian airstrikes on Kyiv and the Zaporizhzhia region.
